requirements: Mandatory (Skill 1): Must have a strong understanding of composition, visual hierarchy, colour theory, typography, and visual design
Mandatory (Skill 3): Must have solid understanding of motion design and animation principles
Mandatory (Portfolio): Must share a portfolio showing high-quality motion design, typography animation, and campaign creatives
Mandatory (Note): Must be willing to work from the Gurgaon (Sector 58) office.
responsibilities: We’re looking for a Motion Graphic Designer to create engaging, high-quality motion creatives, animations, and performance ads while bringing strong visual concepts to life through design, animation, and AI-generated content.
Design and animate visual creatives using Adobe Photoshop and After Effects, including products, graphics, typography, and campaign concepts.
Create short-form motion creatives for performance marketing ads across digital platforms, ensuring strong visual impact and engagement.
Develop AI-powered visuals and transformations and integrate AI-generated assets into creative campaigns.
Create smooth animations, transitions, and motion sequences using principles of timing, easing, and the Graph Editor.
Enhance creatives with music and sound design to create engaging and polished motion content.
Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to translate concepts into high-quality motion creatives while maintaining strong visual consistency and attention to detail.
